subject: Request: SLA exception & evidence for weekend 503 spike
messages:
From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@ledgerx.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@ledgerx.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Unexpected 503s during weekend load spike — request for exception/credit

Hi Karthik,

We saw a recurring set of 503s and failed requests against your API during a scheduled batch run on Sun 2027-06-27 between ~02:30–03:15 UTC. Impact: several customer checkout sessions failed, estimated ~1.8% dropped transactions for that hour.

Quick details:
- Region: us-west-2 (our account pinned to shared-hosted)
- Endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings (mostly generate)
- Example times: 2027-06-27T02:31:12Z – 02:45:03Z (spike), 2027-06-27T02:58:19Z – 03:04:50Z (secondary blip)

We need confirmation of any downtime window that would qualify for SLA credit, and we are also requesting an expedited exception: due to the batch nature of our traffic (scheduled every Sunday), we ask Redwood to consider a one-time grace-period exception to avoid immediate revenue disruption while we finalize a retry/backoff fix.

I've attached a compressed telemetry bundle (ledgerx_telemetry_20270627-logs.tar.gz) with sample traces and status codes. Also looping in legal.

Can you confirm next steps and an expected timeline for the evidence review?

Thanks,
Sara Holt
Head of Platform — LedgerX Inc.
Sara.holt@ledgerx.com

Attachments: ledgerx_telemetry_20270627-logs.tar.gz (12 MB)
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Sara Holt <sara.holt@ledgerx.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Unexpected 503s during weekend load spike — request for exception/credit

Hi Sara — thanks for the details and the log bundle. We’ve received the attachment and I’ve started an evidence collection request with SRE.

Next steps from our side:
1) SRE will validate whether the observed intervals meet our SLA definition of "service unavailability" and compute a pro-rata credit if applicable.
2) If there’s an operational nuance (e.g., orchestrator preemption, routing failover), we’ll capture the exact windows and the token-level impact.
3) We’ll propose a remedy: standard SLA credit calculation OR, if eligible and with business justification, a one-time grace/exception.

I’ve looped Laura (Escalations) to coordinate the credit path and Aditya (Customer Success) for remediation options. We aim to come back within 48 hours with an interim finding and a proposed remedy.

Appreciate the bundle — that helps.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — attaching the additional CSV extract that maps request_ids to customer order ids (slo-eval-summary-20270628.csv). The bundle includes a short README describing our batch run (scheduled via in-house orchestrator at 02:30 UTC every Sunday).

We'd appreciate it if you can prioritize this: the window overlaps with our peak settlement window and it's materially affecting our June close. If a grace exception is possible, LedgerX would accept a short, documented one-time concession while we implement backoff and retries on our side.

Regards,
Sara

Attachments: slo-eval-summary-20270628.csv (45 KB)
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0400
Subject: Internal: LedgerX — quick triage + eligibility ask

Team — FYI: LedgerX (deal DX-4871) has provided telemetry for the 02:30–03:15 UTC window on 2027-06-27. They’re requesting an expedited exception/grace period in lieu of immediate credit enforcement because the outage hit a scheduled settlement run.

Questions for SRE (PrIyom):
- Can you validate whether the two intervals reported (02:31–02:45 and 02:58–03:05) meet the SLA "service unavailable" threshold? Please surface preemption events, region routing failovers, and any control-plane noise.
- If eligible, compute token-level impacted percent and a pro-rata credit figure for June.

Laura/Aditya — if SRE confirms partial eligibility, is there precedent for offering a one-time grace/exception (documented, not future precedent) instead of applying the full pro-rata credit? They’ve offered to accept a documented concession while they remediate client-side backoff.

I’ve attached the bundle from the customer locally and flagged the HubSpot deal.

Thanks — K
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: Sara Holt <sara.holt@ledgerx.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:00:00 -0400
Subject: Findings and proposed remedy for 2027-06-27 02:30 UTC spike

Hi Sara — thanks again for the logs and patience while we validated the event. Summary of findings from our SRE review:

- Confirmed impact windows (redwood-observed): 2027-06-27T02:31:08Z – 2027-06-27T02:45:17Z (14m9s) and 2027-06-27T02:58:19Z – 2027-06-27T03:05:04Z (6m45s). Total considered unavailability: ~20m54s.
- Root cause signals: transient autoscaler thrash on a shared pool (us-west-2), compounded by a burst of long-running model initializations coincident with LedgerX's scheduled batch. No control-plane outage; behavior was autoscaler churn that temporarily dropped serving capacity while containers warmed.
- Impact: ~1.6% of requests returned 503s in the hour window you reported (we computed token-level impact and cross-referenced your request_ids).

Eligibility & remedy options under the current SLA:
1) Standard path: eligible for pro-rata SLA credit for the impacted interval. Based on our computation, that equates to a 0.7% pro-rated credit on June usage (we've attached the SLO calculation sheet).
2) Alternative (expedited business concession): In recognition of the scheduled-batch business impact and your remediation effort, we can offer a one-time service credit equal to one month of access to Redwood Optimize (non-transferable) AND apply the standard pro-rata credit to your June invoice if you prefer the accounting route. This concession would be documented as a one-off — not an SLA policy change — and requires acceptance by LedgerX Legal (we copied them).

Requested next steps:
- Please confirm which remedy you prefer (apply pro-rata credit to invoice OR accept the service-credit concession + optional pro-rata).
- If you want a formal postmortem, we’ve scheduled a 60-minute meeting: https://calendar.redwoodinference.com/meet/pm-20270630-postmortem (Wed 2027-06-30 16:00 UTC). We’ll include SRE, CS, and your engineering leads.
- Attached: proposed-remedy-offer-20270630.pdf and the SLO calculation sheet (slo-eval-summary-20270628.csv included earlier).

If you accept the concession route, legal can sign a short acknowledgement letter and we’ll get the one-time service credit applied within 2 billing cycles. If you’d rather keep it simple with pro-rata accounting, we can post a credit to June immediately once you confirm.

Apologies for the disruption — we’re also putting an autoscaler smoothing change in the rollout queue to reduce warmup churn for shared pools.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: proposed-remedy-offer-20270630.pdf, slo-calculation-sheet-20270630.xlsx
